about.title: Human direction for AI-made websites
about.name: Sandra Lukic
about.description: Sandra shapes the Webara process around clarity, speed, and taste. AI helps move faster, but every website still needs a person who understands the business, edits the message, and turns raw ideas into a polished digital presence.
about.ownerNote: I built Webara for business owners who want technology to feel useful, not overwhelming. The goal is simple: use AI where it saves time, and use human judgment where it creates trust.

faq.question: How long does it take to build a website?
faq.answer: The first version usually arrives within 7 to 14 days, depending on the scope and how quickly materials are provided.

faq.question: Is this just an AI website generator?
faq.answer: No. We use AI to speed up research, structure, and copy, but the final design, logic, and quality are shaped by a human team.

faq.question: Can I change the text myself?
faq.answer: Yes. This website includes a small AI-style admin panel for editing the main content.

faq.question: Can you help with domain and hosting?
faq.answer: Yes. We can connect the domain, hosting, email forms, and basic analytics.

cta.title: Have an idea for a website?
cta.description: Send us a short note about your business and what you want the website to achieve. Webara will suggest the structure, timeline, and best package.
